gloss: to bring back; to take back home

definitions.gloss: to bring (someone) back; to take back home
definitions.explanation: To go after a person or animal that has left or run away and bring them back to where they belong: a runaway child home, a stray pet back to its owner, a deserter back to the unit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家出|いえで}→家出：12292_iede⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{連|つ}れ{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: I bring back my son, who ran away from home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{迷子|まいご}→迷子：03729_maigo⟧になった⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{連|つ}れ{戻|もど}してきた。
examples.english: My mother brought my lost little brother back from the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{合宿所|がっしゅくじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連|つ}れ{戻|もど}そうとした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{帰|かえ}りたがらなかった→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: They tried to bring the player who had fled back to the training camp, but he did not want to return.

notes:
Transitive and godan: {連|つ}れ{戻|もど}す, {連|つ}れ{戻|もど}した. A compound of ⟦{連|つ}れる→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧ (to take along) and ⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧ (to return something), so the object is a person or an animal, and the word implies the one brought back had left, often against someone's wishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連|つ}れ{戻|もど}す: to bring someone back home
- ⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連|つ}れ{戻|もど}す: to bring someone back to reality (figurative)
- ⟦{無理|むり}やり→無理やり：10526_muriyari⟧{連|つ}れ{戻|もど}す: to drag someone back

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{連|つ}れて{帰|かえ}る→連れて帰る：26157_tsuretekaeru⟧: to take someone home with you — neutral, no sense that they had left
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{戻|もど}す→呼び戻す：07004_yobimodosu⟧: to call someone back
